_comment: Missions are listed in story order. The first incomplete mission is shown as the current objective. type: stat | own_tool | tool_level | tank_level | region | own_vehicle | build | landmark | flag | research_count

missions.title: Clean your first square metre
missions.hint: Hold the CLEAN button and aim at the dusty ground in front of you.

missions.title: Collect your first container of dust
missions.hint: Keep brushing until your dust tank is full.

missions.title: Sell dust at the Dust Exchange
missions.hint: Walk to the yellow Dust Exchange at the base and press INTERACT.

missions.title: Purchase a better toothbrush
missions.hint: Open the SHOP and buy the Jumbo Toothbrush.

missions.title: Upgrade your dust tank
missions.hint: Shop > Suit: a bigger tank means fewer trips.

missions.title: Completely clean the Tutorial Crater
missions.hint: The small crater just north-east of base. Clean 90% of it.

missions.title: Earn 500 credits
missions.hint: Clean, sell, repeat.

missions.title: Buy a Scrubbing Brush
missions.hint: Proper bristles at last.

missions.title: Upgrade any tool to level 2
missions.hint: Shop > Tools > Upgrade.

missions.title: Unlock the Crater Fields
missions.hint: Buy the permit in Shop > Permits. Dust there is worth 1.5x.

missions.title: Unlock your first vehicle
missions.hint: Shop > Vehicles. It appears on the Vehicle Bay pad.

missions.title: Recover the crashed probe
missions.hint: A survey probe crashed deep in the Crater Fields (see the MAP).

missions.title: Clean 1,000 square metres
missions.hint: Bigger tools make this quick.

missions.title: Buy the Electric Scrubber
missions.hint: Your first powered tool. Recharge at base.

missions.title: Build a Solar Array
missions.hint: BUILD menu. Machines need power.

missions.title: Build your first automated collector
missions.hint: BUILD > Automatic Dust Collector. Place it on dusty ground.

missions.title: Unlock the Lunar Highlands
missions.hint: Shop > Permits. Highland dust is worth 2.4x.

missions.title: Produce 1,000 dust through automation
missions.hint: Link collectors to the base or a depot with conveyors.

missions.title: Deploy a cleaning drone
missions.hint: Build a Drone Bay next to a Charging Station.

missions.title: Complete 5 research projects
missions.hint: RESEARCH tab. Research points come from cleaning and salvage.

missions.title: Unlock the Abandoned Research Facility
missions.hint: Salvage and rusty dust await in the west.

missions.title: Recover 10 pieces of salvage
missions.hint: Scrap crates are scattered around the facility.

missions.title: Drive a Vacuum Buggy
missions.hint: A vehicle that cleans while you drive.

missions.title: Build an Automated Shipping Depot
missions.hint: Sells your network's dust automatically.

missions.title: Build a Processing Station
missions.hint: Refined dust is worth three times as much.

missions.title: Unlock the Industrial Expanse
missions.hint: The flat southern plains. Dust worth 6x.

missions.title: Produce 100,000 dust through automation
missions.hint: Scale up: more collectors, rovers and depots.

missions.title: Establish an industrial lunar cleaning base
missions.hint: Operate 20 machines at once.

missions.title: Buy the Industrial Cleaning Truck
missions.hint: 8 metres of pure cleaning power.

missions.title: Buy the Autonomous Swarm Controller
missions.hint: The ultimate handheld tool.

missions.title: Clean 60% of the Great Basin
missions.hint: The enormous crater in the far Crater Fields.

missions.title: Lunar Cleaning Tycoon: earn 10,000,000 credits
missions.hint: You started with a toothbrush.
